landmarks.name: white marble fireplace
landmarks.description: White mantel and marble tile surround with a black firebox and a stepped-frame mirror above it

landmarks.name: cream chaise lounge
landmarks.description: Cream upholstered chaise lounge with dark wood frame next to a tall window

landmarks.name: glass-pane double front doors
landmarks.description: White double doors with tall vertical glass panes and a light rug in front, next to a dark metal two-tiered console table under an ornate carved mirror

landmarks.name: wooden staircase going up

landmarks.name: high-backed white dining chairs
landmarks.description: Tall white upholstered chairs with nailhead trim around a dark table on a patterned rug

landmarks.name: built-in white glass-front hutch
landmarks.description: White lower cabinets and glass-paned upper cabinets recessed into the wall

landmarks.name: dark wood island with white top
landmarks.description: Long dark wood island with a white stone countertop, a built-in microwave, and four dark carved-wood barstools with light cushions

landmarks.name: panel-ready refrigerator and wine cooler
landmarks.description: Tall white cabinet-front double refrigerator and stainless steel unit recessed into the wall with a vertical glass-door wine cooler on its left

landmarks.name: white corner cabinets and sink
landmarks.description: White shaker lower cabinets and corner sink beneath two windows

landmarks.name: stainless steel range with blue knobs
landmarks.description: Large stainless steel stove and oven with blue control knobs under a white range hood

landmarks.name: round glass table with four white chairs
landmarks.description: Round glass-top table with four white upholstered wood-framed chairs and a green plant centerpiece in a windowed corner

landmarks.name: sectional sofa with orange pillows
landmarks.description: Large light-colored sectional sofa with a beige throw blanket and orange and patterned throw pillows on a white leaf-patterned area rug

landmarks.name: stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling stacked stone fireplace with a white mantel, flanked on the right by dark wood built-in shelving

landmarks.name: two dark wicker armchairs by corner windows
landmarks.description: Pair of dark woven wicker armchairs with light throw pillows flanking a small round side table in the corner by tall windows

landmarks.name: three tall woven bottle vases
landmarks.description: Group of three large brown woven bottle-shaped floor vases next to a potted plant in a woven basket near the stairs

landmarks.name: white French doors to dark-paneled space
landmarks.description: Pair of white multi-pane glass French doors opening into a space with dark wood wainscoting and a dark wood desk

landmarks.name: staircase going down
landmarks.description: Staircase with dark wood handrail descending to a beige stone tile floor

landmarks.name: multi-panel abstract wall art
landmarks.description: Horizontal series of rectangular abstract canvas panels in brown, gold, and blue tones mounted on the wall opposite the descending staircase

landmarks.name: dark vanity under round mirror
landmarks.description: Dark wood cabinet vanity with a round mirror mounted on a stacked-stone tile wall, visible through an open doorway

landmarks.name: glass French doors to chalkboard space
landmarks.description: Pair of white multi-pane glass doors opening into a space with a round patterned rug

landmarks.name: large wall-mounted chalkboard under ART letters
landmarks.description: Wide rectangular blackboard in a white frame with three decorative letters spelling 'ART' above it, near two white A-frame easels, a round dotted rug, and floor-to-ceiling white built-in shelving

landmarks.name: upholstered bench under two square frames
landmarks.description: Small patterned upholstered bench beneath two square framed pictures and a high horizontal window at the base of the descending stairs

landmarks.name: lower white door
landmarks.description: White six-panel door with a keypad on the wall next to it, to the right of the upholstered bench

landmarks.name: shelved storage doorway
landmarks.description: Open doorway to the left of the upholstered bench revealing white built-in shelves

landmarks.name: two tall brown woven vases
landmarks.description: Pair of tall dark brown textured floor vases standing in a corner of the stone-tiled passage

landmarks.name: wall-mounted TV with sconces
landmarks.description: Flat-screen TV mounted on a light wall, flanked by two rectangular vertical wall sconces above a dark leather armchair in a carpeted space

landmarks.name: beige sofa with striped pillows
landmarks.description: Long beige upholstered sofa with dark-and-light striped throw pillows and two dark wood trunks used as a coffee table

landmarks.name: round dark table with four black chairs
landmarks.description: Dark wood round table surrounded by four black leather chairs in the corner beneath two wide windows

landmarks.name: dark wood bar with three stools
landmarks.description: Dark wood bar counter with a grey top and three metal-legged cushioned barstools on a stone-tiled floor

landmarks.name: dark wood cabinets with mosaic backsplash
landmarks.description: Dark stained wood upper and lower cabinets with a grey countertop and a small-tile brown and gold mosaic backsplash behind the bar

landmarks.name: stone-walled wine rack alcove
landmarks.description: Small open space lined with stone tiles and metal wall-mounted wine racks

landmarks.name: glass-panel door to exercise equipment
landmarks.description: White door with a large upper glass pane propped open along the stone-tiled passage

landmarks.name: double white closet doors
landmarks.description: Pair of white paneled closet doors with silver handles along the lower passage

landmarks.name: doorway with toilet and reddish framed art
landmarks.description: Open doorway showing a toilet and towel bar, with a square reddish painting on the wall to its right at the end of the passage

landmarks.name: dark-framed floor mirror
landmarks.description: Tall rectangular mirror in a dark frame leaning against the wall inside the doorway near the end of the lower passage

landmarks.name: bed with dark metal headboard
landmarks.description: Bed with white and brown bedding and a dark metal grid headboard

landmarks.name: metal weight rack and bench
landmarks.description: Grey metal squat rack and black adjustable weight bench on a black rubber floor mat in front of a large wall-mounted mirror

landmarks.name: treadmill and elliptical machine
landmarks.description: Silver and black treadmill and elliptical machine standing side by side on a light wood floor near a high ledge with a small TV and recessed square window

landmarks.name: recessed wall niche with art
landmarks.description: White-trimmed square wall cutout containing a vertical textured artwork and a small vase at the top of the main stairs

landmarks.name: black console table under mirror
landmarks.description: Dark three-tiered console table beneath a square silver-framed mirror on the upper landing

landmarks.name: upstairs double white doors
landmarks.description: Pair of white six-panel doors with silver lever handles on the upper landing

landmarks.name: patterned armchair under girl painting
landmarks.description: Wide armless upholstered chair with a throw blanket, under a small painting of a girl in a dress

landmarks.name: wire-shelved closet with small window
landmarks.description: Narrow space lined with white wire shelving on both walls and a small square window at the end

landmarks.name: white vanity with mirror and sconces
landmarks.description: White cabinet vanity with a beveled mirror flanked by two vertical wall sconces

landmarks.name: bed with arched white headboard
landmarks.description: Single bed with white bedding, a dark throw pillow, and a white arched headboard between two small high windows

landmarks.name: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
landmarks.description: Large bed with a dark wood headboard, white bedding, a grey throw blanket, flanked by dark nightstands and white-shaded lamps under a tray ceiling

landmarks.name: dark dresser under round sunburst mirror
landmarks.description: Low dark wood dresser beneath a large round mirror with a textured gold-and-silver sunburst frame

landmarks.name: double glass doors to balcony
landmarks.description: White-framed double glass doors with a transom window above and tall narrow windows on either side, next to a cream armchair in the corner

landmarks.name: built-in white dresser and shelves
landmarks.description: White built-in lower drawers and upper open shelving recessed into the wall along a short passage with a plush white runner rug and two wire-shelved closets

landmarks.name: freestanding oval bathtub under window
landmarks.description: White freestanding oval soaking tub with a grey towel draped over the side beneath a wide window, across from a white vanity

landmarks.name: tiled walk-in shower with bench
landmarks.description: Walk-in shower lined with light grey-and-beige striped stone tiles, a built-in tiled bench on the right, and silver fixtures

landmarks.name: bed with blue-gray headboard and green throw
landmarks.description: Bed with a patterned blue-gray upholstered headboard, dark bedding, and a light green throw blanket beside a colorful geometric patterned rug and a dark open shelving unit next to a wall-mounted letter 'B'

connections.how: Turn away from the white marble fireplace and cream chaise lounge to face the doorway flanked by the built-in white glass-front hutch on the right and high-backed white dining chairs on the left.

connections.to: dark wood island with white top
connections.how: Pass the built-in white glass-front hutch on your right and high-backed white dining chairs on your left, walking straight through the doorway toward the dark wood island with white top.

connections.from: dark wood island with white top
connections.how: With the dark wood island on your left and stainless steel range on your right, walk straight through the doorway between the high-backed white dining chairs on the right and built-in white glass-front hutch on the left.

connections.from: dark wood island with white top
connections.how: Pass between the dark wood island on the left and panel-ready refrigerator and wine cooler on the right, then turn right through the doorway before the stone fireplace to reach the top of the staircase going down on the left.

connections.to: dark wood island with white top
connections.how: At the top of the staircase going down, turn right and walk through the doorway past the panel-ready refrigerator on your left to reach the dark wood island with white top.

connections.to: upholstered bench under two square frames
connections.how: Walk straight down the staircase to the beige stone tile floor, where the upholstered bench under two square frames is directly ahead between the shelved storage doorway on the left and lower white door on the right.

connections.from: upholstered bench under two square frames
connections.how: Facing the upholstered bench, turn left and climb the staircase going up to the dark wood floor.

connections.from: upholstered bench under two square frames
connections.how: From the upholstered bench at the bottom of the stairs, turn around to the right around the staircase railing and walk straight down the stone-tiled passage toward the two tall brown woven vases on the left.

connections.to: upholstered bench under two square frames
connections.how: With the two tall brown woven vases on your right, walk straight down the stone-tiled passage to the upholstered bench under two square frames at the bottom of the stairs.

connections.to: doorway with toilet and reddish framed art
connections.how: At the two tall brown woven vases, turn left around the corner and walk down the passage past the glass-panel door and double white closet doors on the left toward the open doorway with the toilet and reddish framed art straight ahead.

connections.from: doorway with toilet and reddish framed art
connections.how: Just before reaching the doorway with the toilet and reddish framed art, turn right through the open doorway to pass the dark-framed floor mirror on the left and reach the bed with the dark metal headboard.
Walk out the doorway past the dark-framed floor mirror onto the stone-tiled passage, where the stone-walled wine rack alcove is ahead on the left.
Step out of the stone-walled wine rack alcove and turn right to reach the corner with the two tall brown woven vases.
At the two tall brown woven vases, turn left around the corner and then immediately left into the stone-walled wine rack alcove.

connections.from: dark wood island with white top
connections.how: Walk past the dark wood island on your left toward the corner windows to reach the white corner cabinets and sink.

connections.to: stainless steel range with blue knobs
connections.how: Turn left at the white corner cabinets and sink to walk between the dark wood island on your left and the stainless steel range with blue knobs on your right.

From the doorway by the built-in white glass-front hutch, walk forward past the white marble fireplace on the right and curve left around the cream chaise lounge toward the glass-pane double front doors and the wooden staircase going up on the left.
Climb the two-flight wooden staircase past the three metal leaf wall sculptures on the left to reach the upper landing with the recessed wall niche with art and the black console table under mirror.
From the upper landing by the black console table under mirror, turn toward the stairs and walk down the two-flight wooden staircase past the three metal leaf wall sculptures on your right.

At the top of the stairs by the recessed wall niche, turn left and walk past the upstairs double white doors on your left through the end doorway toward the patterned armchair under the girl painting.
Before reaching the patterned armchair, turn right into the narrow passage and walk straight past the white vanity doorway into the wire-shelved closet with a small window.
Turn around in the wire-shelved closet and walk straight out past the white vanity with mirror and sconces on your right to reach the bed with the arched white headboard ahead.

From the bed with the arched white headboard, walk past the patterned armchair and exit through the doorway, passing the upstairs double white doors on your left to reach the recessed wall niche and black console table under mirror.

connections.to: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
connections.how: Pass the black console table under mirror and walk through the open double doorway into the space with the bed with the dark wood headboard and white bedding.

connections.from: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
connections.how: Just inside the double doorway before the bed with the dark wood headboard, turn toward the narrow passage with the white runner rug to pass the built-in white dresser and shelves and wire-shelved closets on the left.

connections.to: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
connections.how: Walk back along the white runner rug with the built-in white dresser and shelves on your right to return to the bed with the dark wood headboard and white bedding.

connections.from: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
connections.how: Walk out through the open double doorway to return to the upper landing by the black console table under mirror.

connections.to: bed with blue-gray headboard and green throw
connections.how: From the black console table under mirror, walk past the recessed wall niche on your right and enter the doorway just before the upstairs double white doors to reach the geometric patterned rug, dark open shelving unit next to letter B, and bed with the blue-gray headboard.

connections.from: bed with blue-gray headboard and green throw
connections.how: Walk across the geometric patterned rug past the dark open shelving unit next to letter B on your left, exit the doorway onto the landing, and turn right toward the black console table under mirror.

connections.to: stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves
connections.how: At the bottom of the wooden staircase going up with the glass-pane double front doors on your left, turn right and walk past the three tall woven bottle vases on your left and staircase going down on your right to enter the doorway beside the stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves.

connections.from: stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves
connections.how: Pass between the stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves on your left and the panel-ready refrigerator and wine cooler on your right, stepping through the doorway to reach the staircase going down on your left.

Just before reaching the two tall brown woven vases on the left, turn right through the wide opening into the carpeted space with the wall-mounted TV with sconces on the left and the beige sofa with striped pillows on the right.
Walk out of the carpeted space past the wall-mounted TV with sconces on your right to return to the stone-tiled passage by the two tall brown woven vases.

At the top of the staircase going down, turn left and walk past the three tall woven bottle vases on your right and the white French doors to the dark-paneled space on your left to reach the glass-pane double front doors.

Turn away from the glass-pane double front doors and walk past the wooden staircase going up and three tall woven bottle vases on your left and white French doors on your right to reach the staircase going down on the right.

connections.to: glass French doors to chalkboard space
connections.how: With the staircase going down on your left and multi-panel abstract wall art on your right, walk straight down the short passage toward the dark vanity under round mirror and turn right through the glass French doors to the chalkboard space.

connections.from: glass French doors to chalkboard space
connections.to: large wall-mounted chalkboard under ART letters
connections.how: Step through the glass French doors onto the round patterned rug, with two white A-frame easels by the window ahead, built-in white shelving on the left, and the large wall-mounted chalkboard under ART letters on the right.

connections.from: large wall-mounted chalkboard under ART letters
connections.how: Exit through the glass French doors, turn left past the staircase going down and three tall woven bottle vases on your right, and turn right at the glass-pane double front doors to climb the wooden staircase going up.

connections.from: bed with dark wood headboard and white bedding
connections.how: Walk past the bed with the dark wood headboard on your left and the dark dresser under round sunburst mirror on your right to reach the double glass doors to the balcony and the cream armchair in the corner.

Turn away from the double glass doors to the balcony, walk past the dark dresser on your left and the bed on your right, and turn right into the short passage with the white runner rug and built-in white dresser and shelves.

Walk to the end of the white runner rug past the built-in white dresser and second wire-shelved closet on your left, step onto the tiled floor with the freestanding oval bathtub ahead, and turn right into the tiled walk-in shower with bench.
Step out of the tiled walk-in shower and walk straight back along the white runner rug with the built-in white dresser and shelves on your right.

connections.from: stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves
connections.to: two dark wicker armchairs by corner windows
connections.how: In front of the stone fireplace, walk across the leaf-patterned area rug between the fireplace and the sectional sofa with orange pillows toward the two dark wicker armchairs by the corner windows.

connections.from: two dark wicker armchairs by corner windows
connections.to: round glass table with four white chairs
connections.how: Turn around from the corner windows and walk past the two dark wicker armchairs and sectional sofa on your right toward the dark wood island and the round glass table with four white chairs by the opposite windows.

connections.from: round glass table with four white chairs
connections.to: stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves
connections.how: Turn left away from the round glass table and walk between the sectional sofa on your left and the dark wood island on your right toward the doorway between the stone fireplace and the panel-ready refrigerator.

connections.to: round dark table with four black chairs
connections.how: Walk deeper into the carpeted space with the beige sofa with striped pillows on your left to reach the round dark table with four black chairs in the windowed corner.

connections.from: round dark table with four black chairs
connections.to: dark wood cabinets with mosaic backsplash
connections.how: Turn around from the round dark table to face the dark wood bar with three stools, then walk past the stools on your left and turn right behind the bar to reach the dark wood cabinets with mosaic backsplash.

connections.from: dark wood cabinets with mosaic backsplash
connections.how: Walk out from behind the dark wood bar and cross the carpeted space with the beige sofa with striped pillows on your right.

connections.from: doorway with toilet and reddish framed art
connections.how: Turn around from the doorway with the toilet and reddish framed art and walk back down the stone-tiled passage past the double white closet doors on your right to the glass-panel door on your right.
Turn right through the open glass-panel door and turn right again to face the metal weight rack and bench in front of the mirror wall.
From the metal weight rack and bench, turn left and walk past the glass-panel doorway toward the treadmill and elliptical machine under the high ledge TV and small window.

walk_summary: Start by spinning in place between the white marble fireplace, cream chaise lounge, wooden staircase going up, glass-pane double front doors, high-backed white dining chairs, and built-in white glass-front hutch.
Walk through the doorway between the high-backed white dining chairs and built-in white glass-front hutch to the dark wood island with white top and panel-ready refrigerator.
Turn right before the sectional sofa and turn left down the staircase going down to the upholstered bench under two square frames on the stone-tiled floor.
Make a U-turn to the left around the staircase and walk down the stone-tiled passage past the two tall brown woven vases toward the doorway with the toilet and reddish framed art.
Turn right through the open doorway past the dark-framed floor mirror, walk around the bed with the dark metal headboard, and exit back into the passage by the stone-walled wine rack alcove.
Turn right and walk down the stone-tiled passage past the two tall brown woven vases to the upholstered bench, then turn left and climb the staircase back to the wood-floored level.
Turn right at the top of the stairs, walk past the dark wood island to the white corner cabinets and sink, and turn left around the island past the stainless steel range with blue knobs.

Walk straight through the doorway between the high-backed white dining chairs and built-in white glass-front hutch, curve left around the cream chaise lounge by the glass-pane double front doors, and climb the two-flight wooden staircase to the upper landing with the recessed wall niche with art and black console table under mirror.
Turn left past the upstairs double white doors into the end doorway toward the patterned armchair under the girl painting, then curve right into the wire-shelved closet with a small window.

Turn around and walk out past the white vanity with mirror and sconces to the bed with the arched white headboard, then exit past the patterned armchair and upstairs double white doors to the upper landing.

Step onto the top of the wooden staircase past the three metal leaf wall sculptures, then turn around and walk past the black console table under mirror through the double doorway toward the bed with the dark wood headboard and white bedding.
Turn right into the short passage with the white runner rug and built-in white dresser and shelves, then turn around and exit back onto the upper landing.

Walk past the black console table and recessed wall niche into the doorway before the upstairs double white doors, loop around on the geometric patterned rug by the bed with the blue-gray headboard and dark open shelving unit next to letter B, and exit to the landing.

Turn right and walk down the wooden staircase toward the glass-pane double front doors, then turn right past the three tall woven bottle vases and staircase going down to enter the space with the dark wood island, sectional sofa with orange pillows, panel-ready refrigerator and wine cooler, and stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves.
Turn around, exit past the stone fireplace, and walk down the staircase going down to the upholstered bench under two square frames.

Turn right and walk down the stone-tiled passage toward the two tall brown woven vases, turning right into the carpeted space with the wall-mounted TV with sconces and beige sofa with striped pillows.
Exit the carpeted space to the two tall brown woven vases, turn left toward the glass-panel door to exercise equipment, and step left into the stone-walled wine rack alcove.
Step out of the wine rack alcove, turn left past the two tall brown woven vases, walk to the upholstered bench, and climb the staircase going up.

Turn left at the top of the stairs and walk past the three tall woven bottle vases and white French doors to the dark-paneled space toward the glass-pane double front doors, then turn around and return to the top of the staircase going down.

Walk past the staircase going down on the left and multi-panel abstract wall art on the right toward the dark vanity under round mirror, then turn right through the glass French doors into the space with the round patterned rug, two white A-frame easels, built-in white shelving, and large wall-mounted chalkboard under ART letters.

Exit through the glass French doors, turn left past the staircase going down and three tall woven bottle vases, and turn right by the glass-pane double front doors to climb the wooden staircase going up.

At the upper landing, turn right through the double doorway toward the bed with the dark wood headboard, then turn left onto the white runner rug to look into the wire-shelved closet next to the built-in white dresser and shelves.
Turn around and walk past the bed with the dark wood headboard and dark dresser under round sunburst mirror to the double glass doors to the balcony and cream armchair in the corner.

Turn around, walk back past the dark dresser and bed, and turn right along the white runner rug past the built-in white dresser and second wire-shelved closet into the tiled area with the freestanding oval bathtub and tiled walk-in shower with bench.
Exit the shower, walk back along the white runner rug, pass the bed with the dark wood headboard, and exit onto the upper landing to descend the wooden staircase to the glass-pane double front doors.
Turn left at the bottom of the stairs, walk past the three tall woven bottle vases and staircase going down, and enter the space with the stone fireplace with dark built-in shelves.

Walk past the stone fireplace and two dark wicker armchairs by the corner windows, loop around the sectional sofa with orange pillows on the leaf-patterned rug, and walk toward the dark wood island and round glass table with four white chairs.
Turn left and walk between the sectional sofa and dark wood island, exit between the stone fireplace and panel-ready refrigerator, and descend the staircase going down to the upholstered bench.

Turn right down the stone-tiled passage past the two tall brown woven vases and turn right into the carpeted space, walking past the beige sofa with striped pillows to the round dark table with four black chairs.
Turn around and walk past the dark wood bar with three stools to the dark wood cabinets with mosaic backsplash behind the bar.

Exit the bar and carpeted space back to the two tall brown woven vases, turn right past the glass-panel door and double white closet doors to the doorway with the toilet and reddish framed art, then turn around and enter the glass-panel door on the right to see the metal weight rack and bench, mirror wall, and treadmill and elliptical machine.
